items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: McNeal Breaux ... [INTERVIEWER] ... no, not Johnny.

ctx.x: I, I didn't play it too. But, no, not Johnny. What did you say? Which kind of Phillips? Bill. Bill Phillips. Oh, I'm getting confused. There's so many Phillips.

Bill Phillips. Bill Phillips plays drum himself. And, uh, oh, I don't know. Who was in that band now? I play with so many different little outfits. And I think Lionel Woods was along in there on guitar too. He came along with, with Bill Phillips. Joe Snyder was in there. Um, practically, practically the whole Creston City High had us change over to Billy Phillips. I think that's the way it was. The Creston City High had us disband and Billy Phillips took over. We're practically the same musician with the…
